updates.note: Delivered growth of 3.1% for the full year FY26 in constant currency terms, which is within/above the upgraded guidance.
updates.quote: We had growth of 3.1% for the full year in constant currency terms.

updates.note: Delivered full year operating margins at 21%, within the 20% to 22% guidance.
updates.quote: if you look at the margins, the full year margins is at 21%.

updates.note: Delivered more than 20,000 freshers hired for FY26.
updates.quote: We had announced 20,000 for FY26 and we have hired more than 20,000 freshers from the market.

updates.note: Reiterated expectation to hire at least 20,000 freshers in FY27.
updates.quote: This year also, we are expecting at least 20,000 freshers to be hired.

new_promises.statement: Revenue growth guidance for FY27 is 1.5% to 3.5% in constant currency.
new_promises.quote: Our revenue growth guidance for the financial year 2027 is 1.5% to 3.5% growth year-on-year in constant currency terms.
new_promises.speaker: Salil Parekh

new_promises.statement: Operating margin guidance for FY27 is 20% to 22%.
new_promises.quote: Our operating margin guidance for financial year '27 is 20% to 22%.
new_promises.speaker: Salil Parekh

new_promises.statement: Expect effective tax rates for FY27 to be in the range of 29% to 30%.
new_promises.quote: We expect effective tax rates for the FY27 to be in the range of 29% to 30%.
new_promises.speaker: Jayesh Sanghrajka
